Name: Sleep's Scarecrow Replacers
Author: sleeplessavenue
Description:
I first made these scarecrow replacers forever ago, for a couple of reasons. First, Turnip-head's arms are supposed to go straight out, they aren't floppy! Second, the girl and the witch were just plain ugly to me. Third... well, they all needed some touch-ups. The changes should all be pretty obvious, some more than others, but these were mostly made for myself! After learning a bit more about how modding works, though, I decided to try my hand at upgrading this one. So, here we are, with a fully upgraded scarecrow replacer mod.

You're free to use my code as a base to make your own scarecrow replacements, tweak my images a bit or switch them out if they aren't to your liking, and if you don't want one of them changed you can easily turn one off without turning off the others! It's even compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿. (I hope.)

Also, yes, I made rarecrow number 7 a mouse. I didn't know it was supposed to be a [i]raccoon[/i], and it's [i]TOO LATE NOW[/i].
